_note: Prompts for Meshy text-to-3D. Tuned for the Math Editorial look: matte, sculptural, few colours, no text/logos. Edit freely, then run `npm run meshy:preview -- <name>`.

astrolabe.use: Experience section (alternative to the procedural Bloch sphere)
astrolabe.prompt: an armillary sphere astrolabe, nested thin brass rings around a small polished sphere, engraved degree markings, elegant scientific instrument, studio product shot
astrolabe.negative_prompt: text, logo, base plate clutter, low quality, noisy texture

telescope.use: Stellar Mapping case study (replaces the 7.4MB JWST model)
telescope.prompt: James Webb Space Telescope model, large golden hexagonal segmented primary mirror made of 18 hexagon tiles, tripod secondary mirror struts, five-layer silver diamond-shaped sunshield underneath, spacecraft bus, floating, no ground, detailed scale model
telescope.negative_prompt: ground telescope, tripod stand, refractor tube, eyepiece, text, logo, low quality

flute.prompt: Indian bamboo flute bansuri, long natural light-brown bamboo tube with visible nodes, one embouchure hole and a row of seven finger holes, wrapped with dark red silk thread bindings at both ends and the middle, lying horizontally, product shot
flute.negative_prompt: metal flute, western concert flute, keys, hands, person, text, plain cylinder, low quality

orrery.prompt: a small antique brass orrery with thin arms holding matte planets, standing on a stack of three closed leather-bound books, editorial still life
orrery.negative_prompt: text on books, logo, clutter, low quality

knight.prompt: a single Staunton chess knight piece, polished dark walnut wood with a felt base, classic horse head carving, studio product shot
knight.negative_prompt: board, other pieces, text, hands, low quality

glove.prompt: a single red leather boxing glove with white laces and stitching, side view, studio product shot
glove.negative_prompt: pair of gloves, hands, person, text, logo, low quality

torii.prompt: a small vermilion red Japanese torii gate with black top beam (kasagi), standing on a flat grey stone base, miniature model
torii.negative_prompt: text, kanji signs, people, trees, landscape, low quality
